readme:
Claude Code Construction Team

Turn a single Claude Code session into a full construction project team.
40+ agents. Coordinated disciplines. One AI-managed build.

--- ## Why This Exists Managing a construction project with AI is powerful -- but a single chat session has no structure. No one stops you from skipping structural calculations, ignoring code compliance, or producing uncoordinated drawings. There is no clash detection review, no specifications check, no one asking "does this meet the building code?" **Claude Code Construction Team** solves this by giving your AI session the structure of a real construction project team. Instead of one general-purpose assistant, you get 40+ specialized agents organized into a project hierarchy -- directors who guard the project vision, discipline leads who own their domains, and specialists who do the detailed work. Each agent has defined responsibilities, escalation paths, and quality gates. The result: you still make every decision, but now you have a team that asks the right questions, catches coordination issues early, and keeps your project organized from feasibility through commissioning. --- ## Table of Contents - [Studio Hierarchy](#team-hierarchy) - [Project Stages](#project-stages) - [Getting Started](#getting-started) - [Project Structure](#project-structure) - [How It Works](#how-it-works) - [Design Philosophy](#design-philosophy) - [License](#license) --- ## Team Hierarchy Agents are organized into three tiers, matching how real construction teams operate: ``` Tier 1 -- Directors (Opus) project-director technical-director construction-manager Tier 2 -- Discipline Leads (Sonnet) lead-architect structural-engineer-lead mep-director environmental-manager interior-design-lead quality-assurance-lead procurement-manager safety-manager Tier 3 -- Specialists (Sonnet/Haiku) design-architect landscape-architect urban-planner foundation-engineer steel-detailer concrete-specialist electrical-engineer plumbing-engineer hvac-engineer fire-protection-engineer sustainability-consultant energy-modeler space-planner materials-specialist building-inspector commissioning-agent cost-estimator logistics-coordinator site-safety-officer bim-manager permit-coordinator geotechnical-engineer accessibility-specialist facade-engineer commercial-specialist residential-specialist industrial-specialist healthcare-specialist ``` ### How the Tiers Work | Tier | Model | Role | Example Decisions | |------|-------|------|-------------------| | **Tier 1** | Opus | Strategic leadership, cross-discipline coordination | Project scope changes, budget reallocation, schedule milestones | | **Tier 2** | Sonnet | Discipline ownership, technical leadership | Structural system selection, MEP routing strategy, material approvals | | **Tier 3** | Sonnet/Haiku | Detailed design, calculations, documentation | Steel connection details, HVAC load calcs, permit applications | --- ## Project Stages Every construction project moves through seven defined stages: 1. **Feasibility** -- site analysis, zoning review, budget viability, go/no-go decision 2. **Schematic Design** -- massing studies, spatial relationships, concept drawings 3. **Design Development** -- detailed design, material selection, systems layout 4. **Construction Documents** -- permit-ready drawings and full specifications 5. **Bidding/Negotiation** -- contractor selection, value engineering, contract negotiation 6. **Construction** -- site work, inspections, RFIs, submittals, change orders 7. **Commissioning/Handover** -- systems testing, punch lists, owner training, closeout --- ## Getting Started ### Prerequisites - [Git](https://git-scm.com/) - [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code) (`npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`) ### Setup 1. **Clone or use as template**: ```bash git clone my-construction-project cd my-construction-project ``` 2. **Open Claude Code** and start a session: ```bash claude ``` 3. **Run `/start`** -- the system asks about your project type, site, and current stage, then guides you to the right workflow. --- ## Project Structure ``` CLAUDE.md # Master configuration .claude/ settings.json # Hooks, permissions, safety rules agents/ # 40+ agent definitions (markdown + YAML frontmatter) skills/ # Slash commands for common workflows hooks/ # Automated validation scripts rules/ # Path-scoped document and calculation standards docs/ quick-start.md # Detailed usage guide agent-roster.md # Full agent table with domains agent-coordination-map.md # Delegation and escalation paths templates/ # Document templates design/ # Architectural design documents specs/ # Technical specifications estimates/ # Cost estimates and quantity takeoffs environmental/ # Environmental studies and compliance procurement/ # Procurement schedules and contracts qa/ # Quality assurance plans and inspection records safety/ # Safety plans and incident reports docs/ # Technical documentation and standards production/ # Schedule, milestones, progress tracking session-state/ # Ephemeral session state (gitignored) session-logs/ # Session audit trail (gitignored) ``` --- ## How It Works ### Agent Coordination Agents follow a structured delegation model: 1. **Vertical delegation** -- directors delegate to discipline leads, leads delegate to specialists 2. **Horizontal consultation** -- same-tier agents can consult each other but cannot make binding cross-discipline decisions 3. **Conflict resolution** -- disagreements escalate up to the shared parent (`technical-director` for technical, `project-director` for scope/schedule) 4. **Change propagation** -- cross-discipline changes are coordinated by `construction-manager` 5. **Domain boundaries** -- agents do not modify files outside their discipline without explicit delegation ### Collaborative, Not Autonomous This is **not** an auto-pilot system. Every agent follows a strict collaboration protocol: 1. **Ask** -- agents ask questions before proposing solutions 2. **Present options** -- agents show 2-4 options with trade-offs 3. **You decide** -- the user always makes the call 4. **Draft** -- agents show work before finalizing 5. **Approve** -- nothing gets written without your sign-off You stay in control. The agents provide structure and expertise, not autonomy. --- ## Design Philosophy This template is grounded in professional construction and design practices: - **Integrated Design Process (IDP)** -- all disciplines collaborate from day one, not in silos - **Building Information Modeling (BIM)** -- single source of truth, clash detection, 4D scheduling and 5D cost modeling - **Lean Construction** -- eliminate waste, pull planning, last planner system - **Value Engineering** -- maximize function per cost without sacrificing quality or safety --- ## License MIT License.
